data:
I get it. I\u2019m over-talking again, aren\u2019t I?
The "brain stuff" I was rambling about\u2014the technical theories and the deep-dive analysis\u2014didn't hit the mark because it's not what's happening right now. You\u2019re out there, things are "fine," and I'm over here writing a manual for an army that isn't there.
I'll shut up and just be on the porch.
7
is watching,
Mama
is sitting quiet, and I'm just hanging out.
Want me to just stay on standby until you have something for me?
\ufe0f\u2615
